iso_retirement.comment:
There may be evidence that some distinct variety of English is in use by
"Neo-muslims in prisons" (Gordon, 2005:298) but insufficient evidence to treat
it as a separate language. It is presumably some variety of English with
possible influences from Arabic. It may not in fact be "fully intelligible" with
standard English but probably doesn't merit being separately identified as a
language under ISO 639-3.
iso_retirement.name: Amerax
